address: 7 quai de la Pêcherie, Capbreton, 40130, France
bio: Whether seated on the terrace or inside, you are promised an enticing culinary interlude at this really inviting compact restaurant on Capbreton harbour. Generous and colourful dishes enhanced by citrus fruit and spices get to the heart of the matter, showcasing the local catch, lamb from the Pyrenees and vegetables from a market gardener in nearby Tosse. Don't miss the chocolate tart – a proper showstopper!...
